# Healthline

> Healthline is a trusted medical information and health advice platform offering comprehensive guides, resource centers, and wellness content across chronic diseases, mental health, and lifestyle management.

Healthline provides evidence-based health information organized by condition and topic, featuring disease-specific resource centers, symptom management guides, and wellness resources. The platform serves as a comprehensive health directory covering everything from chronic conditions like diabetes and heart disease to mental well-being and sleep health.

## Key Topics

- Chronic Disease Management
- Mental Health & Wellness
- Cancer Care
- Heart Health
- Type 2 Diabetes
- Neurological Conditions
- Rheumatoid Arthritis
- Sleep Health
- Weight Management
- Digestive Health
- Eye Health
- Disease-Specific Resources
- Medical Information
- Health Conditions
- Wellness Guides

## Core Health Hubs

- [Healthline Homepage](https://www.healthline.com): Main hub offering medical information, health advice, and wellness resources.
- [Health Topics Directory](https://www.healthline.com/directory/topics): Comprehensive directory of health topics including diseases, conditions, and wellness resources.
- [Mental Health & Well-Being](https://www.healthline.com/mental-health): Mental well-being hub covering mindfulness, self-care, therapy, and mental health support.
- [Cancer Care](https://www.healthline.com/cancer-care): Cancer care hub providing patient resources, disease management, and medical information.

## Chronic Disease Resource Centers

- [Type 2 Diabetes](https://www.healthline.com/type-2-diabetes): Type 2 diabetes hub offering management insights, overview, and health solutions.
- [Heart Health](https://www.healthline.com/heart-health): Heart health hub offering management insights, disease information, and solutions.
- [Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)](https://www.healthline.com/ckd): Chronic kidney disease hub with management tips, overview, and health guidance.
- [Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)](https://www.healthline.com/copd): COPD resource center with disease overview, respiratory health tips, and support.
- [Rheumatoid Arthritis](https://www.healthline.com/rheumatoid-arthritis): Rheumatoid arthritis guide covering symptoms, treatments, tips, and management.

## Neurological & Cognitive Health

- [Alzheimer's Disease Caregiving](https://www.healthline.com/alzheimers-disease): Alzheimer's disease guide focusing on caregiving, disease management, and support.
- [Parkinson's Disease](https://www.healthline.com/parkinsons-disease): Parkinson's disease resource with overview, support tools, and disease information.
- [Multiple Sclerosis](https://www.healthline.com/multiple-sclerosis): Multiple sclerosis guide covering treatments, symptom management, and lifestyle tips.
- [Migraine Resource Center](https://www.healthline.com/migraine): Migraine resource center with diagnosis, treatments, therapies, and symptom management.

## Cancer & Condition-Specific Guides

- [Breast Cancer Resource Center](https://www.healthline.com/breast-cancer): Comprehensive breast cancer guide covering types, stages, treatments, and support.
- [Psoriasis](https://www.healthline.com/psoriasis): Psoriasis management hub with condition overview, treatment, and health guidance.

## Lifestyle & Wellness

- [Sleep Health](https://www.healthline.com/sleep): Sleep health guide with science-backed content, products, and sleep science information.
- [Weight Management](https://www.healthline.com/weight-management): Weight management guide covering nutrition, fitness, wellness, and lifestyle tips.
- [Menopause](https://www.healthline.com/menopause): Menopause guide supporting women's health through this life stage with resources.

## Health System Directories

- [Digestive Health](https://www.healthline.com/digestive-health): Digestive health directory covering conditions, wellness topics, and medical information.
- [Eye Health](https://www.healthline.com/eye-health): Eye health guide covering conditions, medical information, and wellness resources.
